name: Hands-elevated push-up
definition: Place both hands on a fixed bench with feet on the floor. Lower the chest toward the bench, then press away while maintaining the body configuration.

catalogue_anchor.notes: Original broad muscle labels retained separately; not silently promoted to accepted anatomy.

value.start: Place both hands on a fixed bench with feet on the floor.
value.movement: Lower the chest toward the bench, then press away while maintaining the body configuration.
value.finish: Return to extended arms with hands still elevated.
value.range_of_motion: Record bench height and hand placement; use a repeatable lower endpoint.
